content.introduction: The sources provide a snapshot of technology news as of October 29th, 2026, with significant financial and strategic updates. Amazon posts a negative free cash flow of $42.4 billion, while ServiceNow shares plunge 27% due to AI disruption fears. Intel's stock plunges 21% blaming a PC slowdown. Meanwhile, Dell's strategic reset focuses on the XPS brand, and AI cyberattacks are outpacing enterprise defenses. On the regulatory front, New York enacts a ban on 'unsafe' chatbot behavior with kids. The sources also highlight emerging tech trends like AI care agents in urgent care and advancements in smoke detection technology.
